# Prana Dental Miami

> Family, cosmetic and implant dentist in Edgewater, Miami (3050 Biscayne Blvd, Ste 703, Miami, FL 33137). Dr. Aakash Rana, DDS. Mon–Sat 8AM–8PM. (786) 579-0521. English & Spanish. Accepting new patients; most major insurance.
